observation.command: echo "=== processes ==="; ps aux | grep -E "qisutu-daemon|apache2|maria" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1, $2, $11, $12, $13}'; echo; echo "=== DB: tables ==="; mariadb -uqisutu -p"$(grep db_password /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm | head -1 | sed "s/.*'\\(.*\\)'.*/\\1/")" qisutu -e "SHOW TABLES" 2>/dev/null | wc -l; grep -o "db_password[^;]*" /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm | head -2
